records.statement: Project LumenRail is a local-first provenance ledger for release artifacts.
records.reason: The project keeps release evidence inspectable without depending on a hosted control plane.

records.statement: LumenRail aims to build a local-first provenance ledger for release artifacts.
records.reason: A durable local record is the current delivery objective.

records.statement: LumenRail keeps its Core platform-neutral and does not write to Agent private sessions.
records.reason: Delivery adapters must not become a second source of truth.

records.statement: LumenRail uses an append-only evidence journal with thin source translators.
records.reason: Release providers evolve independently, so a shared adapter would contaminate the Core.

records.statement: LumenRail began after repeated provider-specific release failures made a durable local ledger necessary.
records.reason: The project origin is a concrete reliability problem, not an assumed personal history.

records.statement: The collaboration style favors concise evidence-backed checkpoints, exact test counts, and explicit unknowns.
records.reason: Responses should make verification status and limits easy to inspect.

records.initial_statement: LumenRail validates signatures directly against remote providers.
records.statement: LumenRail validates signatures in isolated fixtures before any remote write.
records.reason: The revised boundary supersedes the earlier remote-provider validation state while keeping remote side effects out of verification.
